newsitem.title: UK: UK shares seen building modestly on opening highs.
newsitem.headline: UK shares seen building modestly on opening highs.

text.p: The UK stock market kicked off the week on a positive note on Monday, climbing steadily to new all-time highs on the back of a record performance on Wall Street on Friday.

The FTSE 100 index gained 12.0 points to as high as 3,980.8 points in quiet early dealings, pushing past the previous all-time high of 3,970.5 points set on Friday after benign U.S. price data allayed fears of an imminent U.S. rate rise.
Dealers said the market was set to hold its early gains but were sceptical the bourse would crack the key 4,000 level today, citing moderate volumes and several uninspiring interim reports.
